title: A full mailbox or a slow mail server no longer blocks a person from every Frequency email

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18: email_events shows 10 Transient bounces (5 MailboxFull, 5 expired) that each became a permanent hard_bounce suppression

detail: 2026-11-18: the Resend webhook suppressed every email.bounced as hard_bounce, and the Space send path did the same per Space. Resend relays the SES bounce type: Permanent (no such address), Transient (mailbox full, delivery expired) or Undetermined. Production had 12 Permanent and 10 Transient bounces, so nine people with a full inbox or a slow server were blocked from every email for good. lib/suppression.ts now classifies the bounce (classifyBounce; only an explicit Transient is soft) and a soft bounce suppresses only on its third in 30 days (bounceSuppressionReason, reason soft_bounce_repeat). Permanent, Undetermined and complaints suppress on the first event as before. handleSpaceSendWebhook takes suppressAddress so a Space send records the bounce without suppressing. Data repair after merge: delete the global hard_bounce rows whose only bounce evidence is Transient.

verify.note: Fails on main: the webhook suppresses every bounce as hard_bounce. Passes once the classifier gates suppression on both paths.
